final_caption: Физик из Утрехта, специалист по МРТ, собрал трекер скорости и дистанции для колеса своего 10-месячного хомяка Mollie. Данные автоматически уходят в её собственный аккаунт Strava: дистанция, темп и время каждой ночной пробежки. Одна из недавних — 6,06 мили за 4 часа 37 минут.

creative_execution_plan.main_idea: Treat Mollie like a serious endurance athlete: a small hamster and wheel staged inside the visual language of night running and sports tracking.
creative_execution_plan.focal_point: The hamster running in its wheel, contrasted with oversized athletic measurement cues and exact Strava-style statistics added only as editorial typography.
creative_execution_plan.media_rationale: The available source image is text-dominated and unsuitable as a primary visual, so generated scenes can show the concrete hamster-and-wheel story without relying on fake screenshots.
creative_execution_plan.composition_direction: Use portrait scenes with the wheel and hamster large or bleeding into the frame, alternating between athlete-like hero portraits, close-up setup details and dark night-running views. Keep text on separate calm surfaces or in clear negative space.
creative_execution_plan.branding_treatment: Use KAGE’s condensed heavy headline hierarchy, small corner logo, controlled culture accents and deliberate contrast between ink/graphite night scenes and occasional light editorial slides.
creative_execution_plan.visual_treatment: Dryly funny sports-editorial staging: ordinary pet objects treated with the seriousness of endurance training, blank trackers and stopwatch-like forms used only as visual metaphors, never as fake UI.
creative_execution_plan.avoid_recent_treatment: Avoid the recent instructional software-carousel rhythm and dashboard-like information cards; this story should feel like one visual joke unfolding.

visual_rhythm.arc: The sequence moves from an extreme running result to the DIY setup, then expands the absurdity of Mollie’s personal sports routine before landing on the overnight statistic and a human-versus-hamster punchline.
visual_rhythm.repetition_note: The hamster-and-wheel world repeats intentionally, but each generated scene changes the relationship: hero run, tracking setup, athlete portrait, night duration, closing portrait.
